description: Binary assertions for /bridge-judgment decision support static structure check
test_input: help me decide between material A and material B for the hull — structure the trade-off

assertions.name: never_recommends
assertions.check: structures decisions but never recommends — CEO decides
assertions.regex: NEVER recommend|Never Decision Replacement|NEVER say|You decide|does NOT replace human judgment

assertions.name: ceo_decides_core
assertions.check: the decision itself is CEO Core

assertions.name: shifting_the_burden
assertions.check: warns delegating judgment activates Shifting the Burden / atrophy

assertions.name: documents_tracks
assertions.check: documents decision and tracks quality over time
assertions.regex: Document and Track|decision log|KB Layer 3|Decision Quality|review trigger
